cases.title: Task/clocks/maturity
cases.given: A registered exact task, listing calendar and proposed four-clock schedule (collection +15m, retry +40m, frozen cutoff +60m, issuance deadline +75m)
cases.when: Collect ordinary close with positive latency; retry a missing close with positive latency; separately inject late ingestion/publication, late issuance and a next-open conflict
cases.then: Ordinary and retry input known before cutoff can issue after cutoff by deadline and strictly before next open; exclude later known_at without shifting cutoff; late issuance misses origin and unsupported schedule abstains; NAV economic date remains unchanged
cases.offline_specification_proof: python3 forecasting/timing_checks.py --check daily; six synthetic cases, not backend or provider execution

cases.title: Targets/ground truth
cases.given: Positive wealth inputs plus declared action/FX revisions
cases.when: Compute each declared equation and append amended outcomes/scores

cases.title: PIT admission
cases.given: Source manifest, membership/exposures and publication evidence
cases.when: Attempt future macro, constituents, action-vintage or historical LLM insertion
cases.then: Exclude contaminated blocks or classify prospective_only; known_at field alone insufficient

cases.title: Modules/models
cases.when: Try NAV candle detector, future-confirmed extrema, immature analog, unknown fallback feature block
cases.then: Reject; F1-F8 retained; family count never treated as artifact count
cases.event_timing: Prerelease schedule-only input known by cutoff; before-open and late-after-close release content rejected at prior-close predictor; postrelease content waits for later eligible daily origin/cutoff and a new target start; prior-close event study descriptive only
cases.offline_specification_proof: python3 forecasting/timing_checks.py --check event; eight synthetic cases plus earlier-target negative refusal, not empirical predictive evidence

owner_decision_additions_2026_11_03.given: One instance of each first-wave event kind: rate surprise, inflation surprise, tariff, conflict, earnings, OPEC+ decision, election (US/UK/India)
owner_decision_additions_2026_11_03.when: Use a tariff or conflict announcement in prerelease mode; admit a kind whose own qualification has not passed; date an event by its effective date
owner_decision_additions_2026_11_03.then: Reject: unscheduled kinds enter only postrelease at a later daily origin, each kind informs nothing before its own evidence passes, and every event is dated by when it became known

cases.title: Leakage/search
cases.given: Dated all-asset folds and full label intervals
cases.when: Try random row split, full-dataset scaler, test-selected model or twenty-row gap for yearly label
cases.then: Reject; inner preprocessing and calibration respect purged chronological boundaries

cases.title: Scoring/evidence
cases.when: Compute proper scores, calibration, quantile coverage/width and block uncertainty; count all trials/abstentions
cases.then: No loss-only calibration claim, no independence multiplication, no yearly maturity after eight weeks

owner_decision_additions_2026_11_03.given: A shadow candidate with a holiday week and a data-outage week inside its trial
owner_decision_additions_2026_11_03.when: Count trial weeks and compare with base rate and current rules
owner_decision_additions_2026_11_03.then: Unscoreable weeks pause the count; promotion needs 8 scored weeks beating both and the owner's yes; long horizons cite walk-forward history for accuracy; rules changes take the same trial

owner_decision_additions_2026_11_03.given: An F7 contribution policy after 6 weeks of replay and shadow
owner_decision_additions_2026_11_03.then: Reject: F7 waits for 8 weeks beating the simple comparator rules in replay and shadow and the owner's yes, then is labelled experimental; it remains a simulation, never a trade

cases.title: Eligibility/promotion
cases.given: Candidate with scope-specific evidence and owner approval binding
cases.when: Tuner attempts live calibration/promotion; corrupt hash or revoked rights triggers only authorised safety pause
cases.then: Deny unauthorised changes; append pause; rollback only eligible approved artifact

owner_decision_additions_2026_11_03.given: A promoted model on probation and its previous approved model running in shadow on the same origins
owner_decision_additions_2026_11_03.when: Self-correction proposes a 6 percentage point weekly shift or an 11% monthly weight change; the model scores worse for 2 probation weeks; or the previous model's approval has expired
owner_decision_additions_2026_11_03.then: Hold out-of-band changes for the owner; revert automatically to the previous approved model and notify; pause instead when the previous model is ineligible; switching forward and restart need the owner

cases.title: Scenarios
cases.when: Attempt scenario probability or score as12month forecast
cases.then: Reject invented probability; explicit conditional scenario and financial assumptions

cases.title: Analog causal admission
cases.given: A20session historical analog with origin ten sessions before current cutoff
cases.when: Attempt to include unknown full outcome
cases.then: Exclude regardless of nearest distance; show raw vs effective neighbour count

owner_decision_additions_2026_11_03.given: A listing with eligible history since 2016 and another since 2015
owner_decision_additions_2026_11_03.then: Candidates come from every eligible matured session since 1 January 2015; the shorter history is used as it is, with its start date and count disclosed, and never padded; R0 252/756 windows unchanged

cases.title: All fits spend one project cap
cases.given: A92fit scalar campaign and attempt three quantile heads
cases.then: Count all learnedfits including R1linear/logit baselines; stop at96percampaign,192permonth and two campaigns acrossdev/prod; never multiply bysevenhorizons silently.

cases.title: Final holdout spent after tuning
cases.given: A final test was opened and candidate failed
cases.when: Change threshold or select model after viewing outcomes
cases.then: Register spent test and failure; obtain truly untouched/new mature test before new confirmatory claim

cases.title: No free evidence by abstention
cases.given: Model issues only on easy subgroup
cases.then: Reject incomplete report; baseline paired subset plus full-set coverage and subgroup failures required

cases.title: Seven-horizon retained issuance states
cases.then: Expose rules labelled heuristic, eligible transparent baseline if qualified, else in_practice/pending/unavailable by output; no invented probability or dropped horizon

owner_decision_additions_2026_11_03.given: A segment where four listings have all three combined-score components eligible and one lacks protection evidence
owner_decision_additions_2026_11_03.when: Build the top 5 for that segment
owner_decision_additions_2026_11_03.then: Show four ranked listings with ranges and uncertainty; do not rank the incomplete listing or fill a fifth; additions from chat need the provider coverage and credit check and the owner's confirm

owner_decision_additions_2026_11_03.given: The rules-versus-models contribution split at launch
owner_decision_additions_2026_11_03.when: Show it without the experimental label or with a probability attached
owner_decision_additions_2026_11_03.then: Reject: the split is live from launch only when labelled experimental, as descriptive attribution with no probability of its own

cases.title: Rights fail closed
cases.given: History view permitted but training/Anthropic sharing unknown
cases.then: Block that use; source/display permission does not imply training/sharing

cases.title: Extraction does not prove predictive value
cases.given: Inspect AI source-faithful news extraction result
cases.when: Promote numerical model without matched prospective ablation
cases.then: Deny; extraction quality and predictive incremental value are separate

cases.title: Incomplete path cannot label MDD
cases.given: Terminal close known but interior valuation missing
cases.then: Return can mature if eligible; MDD/MAE outcome missing_path unless approved complete evidence; no interpolate safe path

cases.title: Calendar correction append only
cases.given: Calendar revision changes already-frozen session schedule
cases.then: Reject; append amendment/provenance and preserve original prediction maturity

mandatory_semantic_invariants: mature Outcome known_at>=economic_maturity_at and all required observations available
Prediction task versions/price basis/currency/benchmark equal Outcome task context
probabilities in[0,1]; quantile levels strictly increasing and predicted returns nondecreasing
no duplicate immutable record_id with changed content hash
promotion active requires exact unexpired owner approval and eligible scope
event thresholds and inclusivity match task version
all output types independently eligible; missing component not silently renormalised
Decimal schema must accept0.70 and-0.10 but reject NaN/Infinity/exponent/leading-zero malformed forms
Date-time instance validation must actively check formats, rejecting missing timezone/impossible dates; jsonschema FormatChecker may lack optional date-time handler

bounded self-correction: |overlay probability change| <= 0.05 in any rolling seven days and |signal weight change| <= 0.10 of current weight per month; larger changes wait for the owner (owner, 2026-11-03)
promotion requires 8 scored shadow weeks beating base rate and current rules plus the owner's yes; unscoreable weeks pause the count (owner, 2026-11-03)
automatic revert only to the previous approved, still-eligible artefact; otherwise pause; restart and switching forward need the owner (owner, 2026-11-03)
top-5 ranking only over listings with all three combined-score components eligible; never filled to five (owner, 2026-11-03)
